bio: Dr. Khairy Sayed is an Associate Professor of Electrical Engineering at Sohag University, Egypt, and a former Fulbright Research Scholar at the Smart Grid Interdependencies Laboratory, City College of New York (CCNY), CUNY, USA (2023–2025). He received his B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering from Assiut University (1997), his M.Eng. from Kyungnam University, South Korea (2007), and his Ph.D. from Assiut University (2013), alongside postdoctoral research at the University of Ontario Institute of Technology, Canada (2016). With over 12 years of academic leadership and a prior decade of SCADA/DMS operational engineering in electricity distribution, his research focuses on cutting-edge renewable integration, Photovoltaic Systems (Ground-mounted, Floating-PV, Agri-PV), the Energy-Water-Food Nexus, AI-enhanced techno-economic optimization, and battery storage.

researchInterests.title: Photovoltaic Systems (Ground, Floating-PV & Agri-PV)
researchInterests.description: Design, thermal modeling, MPPT algorithms, and yield optimization for land-based, water-borne Floating-PV, and dual-use Agricultural Photovoltaic setups.

researchInterests.title: Energy-Water-Food Nexus & Desalination Coupling
researchInterests.description: Renewable energy integration with water desalination plants, multi-generation systems, and climate-smart sustainable water-energy infrastructure.

researchInterests.title: Smart Grids, Microgrids & Resiliency
researchInterests.description: Decentralized control, AC/DC microgrid architectures, islanding mitigation, and fault classification using fuzzy-neuro algorithms.

researchInterests.title: Power Electronics & Distributed Energy Resources
researchInterests.description: High-efficiency soft-switching DC-DC converters, multi-level inverters, harmonic minimization, and advanced grid-forming converters.

researchInterests.title: Electric Vehicles & Energy Management (V2G)
researchInterests.description: Fast charging infrastructure, smart charging schedules, Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) bidirectional conversion, and fleet energy optimization.

researchInterests.title: AI Forecasting & Techno-Economic Optimization
researchInterests.description: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, physics-informed digital twins, and metaheuristic solvers for real-time dispatch and grid stability.

researchInterests.title: Battery Energy Storage & BMS
researchInterests.description: Lithium-ion degradation analysis, short-term discharge State-of-Health (SoH) diagnostics, and hybrid energy storage system management.
